demos.title: Isometric London
demos.pitch: Pan an isometric schematic of London startup districts, then click one for a short briefing.
demos.howBuilt: SVG isometric projection of eight named districts. No map tiles and no API keys. Positions are a schematic, not OSM. Built from the tiny.london bookmark by @ktoya_me.
demos.author: ktoya_me

demos.title: Morning bookmark loop
demos.pitch: Press one button to watch the daily agent read the live queue, pick the top pending bookmark, and ship it.
demos.howBuilt: Client state machine over src/generated/queue-preview.json, the same file generate-queue.py writes. Picker rules match scripts/pick-next-demo.mjs. No model calls.
demos.author: jxwalker
